nodes.name: parsers-config.ts
nodes.summary: Declarative registry of tree-sitter parser definitions mapping 26 filetypes to downloadable WASM parser binaries and highlight/local/injection query URLs used for TUI syntax highlighting.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure data module (default-exported object) with no logic; comments document nvim-treesitter query incompatibilities and the 'inherits: ecma' dependency rule when copying queries.

nodes.name: build-node.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the Node.js-target distribution from src/node.ts with Bun.build, embedding all SQL migrations and the release channel as compile-time defines.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: The main Bun.build --compile pipeline producing self-contained cross-platform opencode binaries (12 linux/darwin/windows targets), patching @opentui/core's parser worker to use a static WASM file import with a WASI shim, injecting diff-wasm and embedded Web UI as virtual files, and uploading release artifacts to GitHub.
nodes.languageNotes: Key compile-mode trick: dynamic import(..., { with: { type: "wasm" } }) cannot be resolved by Bun.build --compile, so the worker source string is patched to a static `import ... with { type: "file" }` and injected via Bun.build's `files` virtual-file map, resolving to /$bunfs/root/<name> at runtime.

nodes.name: check-migrations.ts
nodes.summary: CI guard that runs `bun drizzle-kit check` and exits non-zero when the Drizzle schema has changes not captured in generated migrations.

nodes.name: copy-wasm-glue.mjs
nodes.summary: Postinstall helper copying onnxruntime-web's emscripten WASM glue (.mjs factory + .wasm binary) into src/search/wasm so semantic search can embed it in compiled binaries.

nodes.name: fix-node-pty.ts
nodes.summary: Postinstall helper restoring the executable bit on node-pty prebuilt spawn-helper binaries on non-Windows platforms, where archive extraction drops permissions.

nodes.name: generate.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches the models.dev provider catalog (from env-overridable URL or local JSON) and writes the generated src/provider/models-snapshot.js plus its .d.ts declaration.

nodes.name: httpapi-exercise.ts
nodes.summary: One-line launcher that dynamically imports the HTTP API exercise suite from test/server/httpapi-exercise.

nodes.name: postinstall.mjs
nodes.summary: npm postinstall script for the platform-package wrapper that locates the platform-specific opencode binary (opencode-<platform>-<arch>) and links or copies it into bin/.opencode with executable permissions.

nodes.name: publish.ts
nodes.summary: Release orchestration script that publishes platform packages to npm, builds and pushes a multi-arch Docker image, computes release checksums, and updates the Arch AUR PKGBUILD and Homebrew tap formulas.
nodes.languageNotes: Idempotent by design: checks `npm view name@version` before publishing and retries the AUR push loop up to 30 times to tolerate transient clone/checkout races.

nodes.name: run-workspace-server
nodes.summary: Development harness that runs a local opencode server as a simulated remote workspace, watching a JSON state file's mtime and restarting the dev server whenever the workspace definition changes.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensionless Bun script (#!/usr/bin/env bun) — treated as TypeScript by the runtime; uses mtime double-read snapshots to avoid reading a JSON file mid-write.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Generates JSON Schema files for the opencode config and TUI config from their zod schemas, preserving strictness (additionalProperties: false) and surfacing defaults as self-documenting examples.

nodes.name: time.ts
nodes.summary: Micro-benchmark helper that dynamically imports a module path from argv and prints performance.now() after it finishes loading.

nodes.name: trace-imports.ts
nodes.summary: Development CLI that recursively traces the project-internal import chain from a given entry file using the TypeScript compiler API, printing a depth-indented dependency tree.

nodes.name: openapi-translation-cleanup.md
nodes.summary: Incremental 7-PR plan to strip post-generation OpenAPI rewrites from the HttpApi public.ts transform hook until the generated spec is a direct projection of runtime route schemas, without breaking the generated SDK.

nodes.name: tui-plugins.md
nodes.summary: Specification for the TUI plugin system covering author package shape, npm install flow, version compatibility, the plugin API (keymaps, routes, dialogs, KV/state/client/events, themes, slots), lifecycle disposal rules, and the eight built-in internal plugins.

nodes.name: v2/api.ts
nodes.summary: Executable spec exercising the @opencode-ai/core programmatic API end to end: registering tools and an openai agent, creating a session, prompting with text and image attachments, and reading back messages.
nodes.languageNotes: Marked @ts-nocheck — a living usage sketch of the core API surface rather than typechecked production code.

nodes.name: createEmbeddedWebUIBundle
nodes.summary: Builds the web app package and generates a TypeScript module that statically imports every dist file with `with { type: "file" }` and re-exports them as a path map, allowing the Web UI to be embedded in the compiled binary; returns null on failure so builds continue without it.

nodes.name: detectPlatformAndArch
nodes.summary: Maps os.platform()/os.arch() to npm package naming conventions (win32 → windows) to derive the platform-specific binary package name.

nodes.name: findBinary
nodes.summary: Resolves the opencode-<platform>-<arch> package via require.resolve and verifies its bin/opencode(.exe) binary exists, throwing a wrapped error otherwise.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Postinstall entry point: skips setup on Windows (exe ships in the package), otherwise hard-links or copies the resolved platform binary to bin/.opencode and marks it executable.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Publishes one built package directory to npm if the version is not already published, fixing executable permissions first because GitHub artifact downloads can drop the exec bit.

nodes.name: readDataMtime
nodes.summary: Returns the mtime of the dev workspace state file, or undefined when it does not yet exist (ENOENT), rethrowing any other error.

nodes.name: readSnapshot
nodes.summary: Polls until the workspace state JSON can be read atomically, using a before/after mtime comparison to guarantee the file was not rewritten mid-read.

nodes.name: startDevServer
nodes.summary: Spawns `bun run dev serve` as a child process on the port from the workspace state, merging its env overrides and redirecting XDG_DATA_HOME to /tmp/data.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Converts a zod schema to a self-documenting JSON Schema via z.toJSONSchema, forcing additionalProperties: false on objects and promoting string defaults into examples and description suffixes, then flags the result as JSONC-tolerant.

nodes.name: resolveImport
nodes.summary: Resolves an import specifier relative to the importing file, handling alias, absolute, and relative forms.

nodes.name: tryExtensions
nodes.summary: Resolves a bare file path to an actual file by probing directories for an index file and appending common TypeScript/JavaScript extensions.

nodes.name: extractImports
nodes.summary: Parses a TypeScript source file and collects all module specifiers from static import/export declarations and string-literal dynamic import() calls using a recursive AST visitor.

nodes.name: traceFile
nodes.summary: Recursively walks the internal import graph from a file, printing a depth-indented tree, skipping generated files and node_modules, and memoizing visited files to avoid cycles.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that takes a source file argument and starts the import trace from the package root.
